description: Sarphatistraat 163-213 (BAG 1909-10): 6.5 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys over a 4.1 m ground storey; two casements (1.1 m, a 0.3 m pier) and a narrow window (1.3 m) per storey, thin buff speklagen, the narrow axis on the door side so fronts mirror about the party wall; a round-arched pair of house doors against the party wall, two tall ground windows; cream bands; a cream cornice at 14.4 m and a brick wall dormer (tower) over the narrow axis whose neighbour's tower meets it over the party wall

match.note: 3DBAG eaves 13.4-15.5 m on most pands but 8.7-9.2 m on 173/189 and 17.1-18.2 m on 163/185 (the tower or a gable read as the eaves): front eaves are the measured 14.4 m cornice

tower.note: Sarphatistraat 175-181 (2024-12-11 strip, gridded 40 px/m): a brick wall dormer 2.6-3.0 m wide per house over the narrow axis, the two of a door pair meeting over the party wall as one 5.6 m block, 14.5-17.4 m, a flat cream cap, one light 14.7-15.8 m per house

door-right.note: a round-arched pair of brown double doors, 1.8 m each pair half, against the party wall (apex 3.75 m)

roof.evidence: Sarphatistraat 167-179 strip 2017-03-31 (Opus verdict 2026-11-10): above the cornice only sky, chimney pots and the towers; no tile slope shows, so the roof is flat behind the cornice

rhythm.bays: a wide two-light window and a narrow window per storey; ground: two tall windows and the arched door
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pairs: the doors and narrow windows meet at the party wall
rhythm.roofline: cream cornice at 14.4 m, a brick wall dormer over each door pair

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 at 40 px/m, gridded: wide window 2.75 m (two 1.4 m lights) 1.2-3.95 m from the left edge, narrow 1.3 m at 4.75-6.05 m; sills 4.5/7.8/11.1 m, heads 6.6/10.05/13.25 m; ground windows 1.1-3.5 m, arch apex 3.75 m, doors 4.35-6.35 m; cornice 14.25-14.75 m; tower 14.5-17.4 m

schemaLimits: iron balconies on storeys 1-2 under the wide pair (some houses)
fanlight tracery in the arched doors
pale stone corbel blocks at the window-head corners
the tower cap is a flat slab (no white dentil cornice cap: TOWER_CAPS has no cornice)
notes: The strip's exposure falls from bright (left) to dark (right): placed pands take their own measured wall.
